memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Chronic urticaria and stable COPD.
Patient reports occasional itchy wheals on arms, no angioedema. On exam: mild scattered wheals, lungs clear to auscultation, SpO2 94% on room air. Spirometry: FEV1 1.20 L (55% predicted), FVC 2.10 L, FEV1/FVC 0.57; change from baseline not applicable. ACT score 22 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct for tiotropium Respimat and budesonide-formoterol Turbuhaler. Smoking status: former, quit 2008, 30 pack-years.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Levocetirizine 5 mg OD
Cetirizine 10 mg HS
Tiotropium Respimat 2 puffs OD
Salbutamol metered-dose inhaler 2 puffs SOS
Budesonide-formoterol 200/6 Turbuhaler 2 puffs BD

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
CBC: WBC 6.2 x10^9/L, Neutrophils 4.0, Lymphocytes 1.8, Eosinophils 0.3 (normal 0.0-0.5). Hb 12.8 g/dL, Platelets 210 x10^9/L.
Thyroid function: TSH 2.1 mIU/L (0.4-4.0), Free T4 12.5 pmol/L (9.0-19.0).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Chest X-ray PA: Hyperinflated lungs, flattened diaphragms, no focal consolidation or pleural effusion. Consistent with COPD.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Chronic urticaria and COPD, mild exacerbation.
Patient notes increased wheals over trunk, mild dyspnea on walking 200 m. Exam: scattered wheals, lungs with mild wheeze bilaterally, SpO2 92% on room air. Spirometry: FEV1 1.05 L (48% predicted), FVC 1.95 L, FEV1/FVC 0.54; change in FEV1 -0.15 L since last visit. ACT score 18 (not well controlled). Technique corrected: salbutamol MDT coordination instructed. Smoking status unchanged.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Levocetirizine 5 mg OD (continue)
Cetirizine 10 mg HS (stop)
Tiotropium Respimat 2 puffs OD
Salbutamol metered-dose inhaler 2 puffs SOS
Budesonide-formoterol 200/6 Turbuhaler 2 puffs BD
Prednisolone 5 mg OD for 5 days

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via clinic app: 'The hives have improved after stopping cetirizine at night, but I still feel short of breath when climbing stairs.'

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for review with Dr Suresh Menon on 2026-01-10 at 10:00 AM.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Chronic urticaria, improved; COPD stable.
Patient reports occasional mild wheals, no nighttime itching. Denies worsening dyspnea. Exam: few scattered wheals, lungs clear, SpO2 95% room air. Spirometry: FEV1 1.18 L (54% predicted), FVC 2.08 L, FEV1/FVC 0.57; change in FEV1 +0.13 L since last visit. ACT score 21 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct for all inhalers. Smoking status unchanged.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
CBC: WBC 5.9 x10^9/L, Neutrophils 3.8, Lymphocytes 1.7, Eosinophils 0.2. Hb 13.0 g/dL, Platelets 205 x10^9/L.
Thyroid function: TSH 1.9 mIU/L, Free T4 12.8 pmol/L.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: SpO2 at rest: 96% on room air (baseline). No desaturation on 6‑minute walk test.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Chronic urticaria in remission; COPD stable.
Patient denies hives for past 8 weeks. No dyspnea at rest, mild on exertion. Exam: skin clear, lungs clear, SpO2 96% room air. Spirometry: FEV1 1.22 L (56% predicted), FVC 2.12 L, FEV1/FVC 0.58; change in FEV1 +0.04 L since last visit. ACT score 23 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct. Smoking status unchanged.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Levocetirizine 5 mg OD (stop, asymptomatic)
Tiotropium Respimat 2 puffs OD
Salbutamol metered-dose inhaler 2 puffs SOS
Budesonide-formoterol 200/6 Turbuhaler 2 puffs BD

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Chronic urticaria absent; COPD stable.
Patient remains free of wheals. No dyspnea, SpO2 97% room air. Spirometry: FEV1 1.25 L (57% predicted), FVC 2.15 L, FEV1/FVC 0.58; change in FEV1 +0.03 L since last visit. ACT score 24 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct. Smoking status unchanged.
